exact_statement: For every fixed d>=3, every common distribution of strictly positive nearest-neighbor transition vectors whose components sum to one, and every fixed deterministic ell in S^(d-1), let the site rows on Z^d be iid, sample the environment once, and start the walk at 0. Is the annealed probability P_0(lim_n X_n dot ell=+infinity) always 0 or 1?

assumptions.E: Every nearest-neighbor transition probability is positive almost surely; no common positive lower bound is required.
assumptions.IID: Full transition vectors at distinct sites are independent with the same distribution.
assumptions.direction: Fixed deterministic unit direction; equivalent to any fixed nonzero real direction by scaling.
assumptions.probability: Annealed, averaged over the static environment and the path from 0.
